dimensions.description: meme-id: stop_racism_meme; hasOverallIntent: Hateful; overall-intent-description: The meme juxtaposes a monkey with the text 'stop racism' and a baby with 'black children and white children are the same,' using the visual of a monkey to imply that Black children are inferior or less human. This is a harmful and hateful stereotype that equates Black people with primates, which is a well-documented anti-Black racist trope. The intent is to trivialize racism by suggesting that racial differences are irrelevant or that Black people are 'the same' as white people in a degrading, animalistic way, thereby undermining the seriousness of racial injustice and perpetuating harmful racial stereotypes.

dimensions.description: A well-documented racist trope that dehumanizes Black people by equating them with monkeys or apes, implying inferiority, animalism, and lack of humanity. This stereotype has been used historically and in modern media to justify discrimination and violence against Black individuals.

This metaphor is used to downplay systemic racism and racial injustice.
